description: Calculate USD cost differences for up to 50 distinct shipments using supplied invoice/quote amounts and explicit comparability evidence. Excludes mismatched or unknown terms, keeps losses, separates quoted opportunities from invoice differences. Does not fetch rates, verify documents, annualize savings, or book. One candidate per shipment per call.

baseline_source.description: Invoice or incumbent quote reference; do not invent

candidate_source.description: Warp quote ID, final invoice reference, or other supplied evidence

comparison_evidence.description: Explain how the three matching judgments were established, including historical-date differences

included_charges.description: Comparable all-in charges, including fuel and accessorials

service_requirements.description: Both meet required deadline, handling and appointment requirements; not a carrier-quality endorsement

shipment_requirements.description: Same lane, load, dates or explicit historical benchmark, and accessorial requirements

name: compare_freight_costs
title: Compare Freight Costs Against Evidence
